note: 3_deltas.bin and 4_xor_deltas.bin hold uint16 little-endian DIFFERENCES, not weights. Reconstruct with base+delta or base^delta respectively.

files.1_stored.zst: the chunk exactly as stored in the object store
files.2_uncompressed.bin: zstd-decompressed; still byte-shuffled. Hashes to chunk_hash.
files.3_deltas.bin: un-shuffled: target_bits - base_bits mod 2^16 (what the codec uses)

subtract_vs_xor.note: XOR is also an exact bijection (target = base XOR delta) and has no borrow propagation, so unchanged exponent bits stay zero. It still loses: subtraction puts the drift SIGN in the high byte, giving two dominant values (0x00/0xff) in long runs, where XOR gives one value in shorter runs. See ARCHITECTURE.md 4.1.
